name: Copilot Session High Tool-Call Volume
description: Detects Copilot Chat sessions with an unusually high tool_call_count for the actor, which can indicate automated/scripted use of an interactive assistant to enumerate or exfiltrate repository data.

name: Copilot Session Duration Anomaly
description: Detects Copilot Chat sessions whose duration_seconds is far outside the norm for the actor (both unusually long and unusually short), which can indicate automated/scripted use or credential sharing.
